name: provide_faq_link
description: The chatbot directs the user to the frequently asked questions section regarding the CAU.

outputs.description: Link or reference to the frequently asked questions for user assistance

name: provide_contact_information
description: Provides users with various methods to contact the Centro de Atención a Usuarios (CAU) for assistance, including email, phone number, physical address, and operational hours.

outputs.description: Contact details for CAU support, including email, phone number, and physical address.
Standard operational hours for assistance, which are Monday to Friday, excluding holidays, from 9:00h to 17:30h, and details on operational hours during suspension.
Link to frequently asked questions.
Link to the catalog of services offered.
Methods to contact CAU via email, phone, or in person.

name: provide_service_catalogue_reference
description: Directs the user to the service catalogue offered by the Centre for User Attention (CAU) and provides contact information and service hours for further inquiries.

outputs.description: Various ways to contact the CAU, including email, phone, and in-person.
Information about the operational hours for contacting the CAU.
Reference to the catalogue of services offered by the CAU.

name: provide_initial_information
description: The chatbot provides initial instructions on how to obtain help with UAM virtual platforms and Moodle functionalities.

name: prompt_for_password_change
description: Guides the user through the steps to change their password if they have forgotten it, including obtaining any necessary codes.

name: provide_service_information
description: The chatbot provides information about obtaining accounts for external users and integrated services in the ID-UAM system.

outputs.description: Obtaining a student account for first enrollment

name: remind_password_change_frequency
description: The chatbot reminds the user to change their password periodically to avoid account locking.

name: provide_information_on_nia_obtainment
description: The chatbot details the process of obtaining an academic identification number (NIA) for new students.

outputs.description: Information on obtaining a NIA and related account access steps.

name: provide_welcome_day_info
description: The chatbot provides information about the Welcome Day event and its relevance for new students.

outputs.description: URL with details about the Welcome Day.

name: provide_future_students_info
description: The chatbot presents information aimed at future students, including available courses and degrees.

outputs.description: URL with resources for prospective students.

name: provide_admission_to_grados_info
description: The chatbot provides information related to the admission process for degrees (grados) at UAM.

outputs.description: URL with details about admission processes.

name: provide_waitlist_info
description: The chatbot provides information about the waitlist processes for degree admissions.

outputs.description: URL with details regarding admission waitlists.

name: prompt_for_service_detail_type
description: Prompts the user to specify the type of detail they would like about integrated services, including options for features or pricing.

parameters.name: detail_requested
parameters.description: Represents whether the user wants to know about features or pricing of the services.

name: provide_moodle_access_information
description: Explains the requirements for accessing Moodle, including the need for an institutional account and outlines the available environments.

outputs.description: Information regarding the necessity of holding an institutional account to access Moodle.
Details on the two Moodle environments: Grado/Postgrado and Formación.

name: suggest_contact_for_support
description: Suggests the user contact the Oficina de Atención al Estudiante for issues related to virtual platforms at UAM.

name: list_available_buttons
description: Presents a list of buttons available for the user to click on for further assistance related to Moodle access.

outputs.description: Descriptions of the available buttons related to Moodle access issues.

name: provide_user_id_retrieval_support
description: Guides the user on how to retrieve their student ID (ID-UAM) if forgotten, including options for further assistance through the CAU.

outputs.description: Email and options for CAU assistance, including retrieving an ID.
Instructions for obtaining an activation code.
Steps for changing the password and suggestions for periodic password changes.

name: provide_password_setup_information
description: Provides information and steps for setting up a password for the first time after user registration, including instructions for obtaining an activation code and establishing the password.

outputs.description: URL for password establishment steps.

name: provide_activation_code_instructions
description: Instructs the user on how to obtain or generate an activation code for changing their password.

name: present_available_service_options
description: Offers links to resources and services related to ID-UAM, including obtaining identifiers, account setup, and password change procedures.

outputs.description: Links to services include identifier retrieval, integrated services, steps for obtaining student and staff accounts, service information, and password change procedures.
Support contact details for issues related to account setup.
